hints.title: Boundary Event Sweeping
hints.text: Track building start and end edges in ascending coordinate order, maintaining visible peak height changes.

hints.title: Negative Start and Positive End Sorting
hints.text: Distinguish building start edges from end edges using sign. This natural ordering handles overlapping edges cleanly.

hints.title: Sweep-Line with Active Heights
hints.text: Record events (L, -H) and (R, H). Sort events by coordinate with height tie-breaking. Maintain a multiset or max heap of active building heights starting with ground height 0. When the maximum active height changes at an x-coordinate, add [x, max_height] to the skyline.

complexity.notes: Optimal sweep-line with lazy max-heap pruning.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Maintaining a full coordinate height array takes memory and time proportional to coordinate span.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Event sorting and priority queue height tracking executes in O(N log N) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use negative height for start edges to handle ties where taller buildings mask shorter ones.
